description: This file defines an abstract base class and data structures for text-to-speech (TTS) transformation providers within a larger language model framework. It includes type definitions, configuration handling, and method signatures for provider-specific implementations of TTS request and response transformations.

classes.name: TextToSpeechRequestData
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of data used in TTS request payloads, including optional JSON body, SSML/XML body, and headers.

classes.name: BaseTextToSpeechConfig
classes.description: Abstract base class providing an interface for TTS provider configurations, including methods for parameter mapping, URL generation, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of class attributes that are not special functions or None, serving as the static configuration.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to specify supported OpenAI TTS parameters for the provider.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict] map_openai_params( self, model: str, optional_params: Dict, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict]] = None, drop_params: bool = False, kwargs: Dict = {}, )
methods.description: Abstract method to map OpenAI-specific parameters to provider-specific parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to ensure environment readiness and return headers.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full request URL based on model, base URL, and parameters.

methods.name: TextToSpeechRequestData transform_text_to_speech_request( self, model: str, input: str, voice: Optional[str], optional_params: Dict, litellm_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input text and parameters into provider-specific request data, including request body and headers.

methods.name: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent" transform_text_to_speech_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Converts provider-specific raw response into standard format.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Dict )
methods.description: Returns an exception instance for error handling, based on status and message.
